tasks.label: NeoForge: Build Mod
tasks.detail: Builds the mod jar into build/libs/ (e.g. notenoughblocks-1.0.0.jar). On the first run it downloads NeoForge and generates the mapped Minecraft jars, which is what lets VSCode resolve the API.

tasks.label: NeoForge: Generate Sources
tasks.detail: Decompiles and attaches Minecraft + NeoForge sources so VSCode can show API source/docs when you navigate into net.minecraft / net.neoforged classes.

tasks.label: NeoForge: Grant Execution Permission (POSIX)
tasks.detail: Grant execution permission for building script on POSIX-like os. Sudo Password is required while running.
